response.original_title: Frankie Goes To Hollywood: Frankie Said
response.overview: Frankie Goes To Hollywood – Frankie Said (Deluxe Edition) is a CD+DVD compilation released 10 February 2014 on ZTT/Salvo (catalog SALVOSVX024), marking the 30th anniversary of ZTT Records. The DVD includes 7 Top Of The Pops appearances, footage from The Oxford Road Show '84, promo videos, and more — spanning tracks like "Two Tribes," "The Power of Love," and "Relax" (all from a Christmas Day 1984 TOTP broadcast), "Wish (The Lads Were Here)" and "War!" from The Oxford Road Show, plus commercial versions/extended edits of "Relax," "The Power of Love," and "Welcome to the Pleasuredome." It also features an extract from Frankie's 1985 video release From A Wasteland To An Artificial Paradise, and a closing medley pulling from Art of Noise tracks ("Moments in Love," "Close (To the Edit)") alongside Frankie's own hits.
response.title: Frankie Goes To Hollywood: Frankie Said
